summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K announcing a proposed offering of $700 million convertible senior notes due 2031, with an option for initial purchasers to buy an additional $100 million. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, convertible into common shares (or cash/stock combination at Almonty's option), redeemable after July 1, 2029, with a fundamental change repurchase feature. Net proceeds will fund capped call transactions, refinance debt, and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital markets financing, not a special situation event.
